note: How the stack shipped its MCP servers until it stopped (2026-10-24, after f779a349): every server under the name it was registered by, the original name it came from (original-mcps.json is that name's paste-ready entry), the plugin-route entry the marketplace listed (its launcher resolved the Python, the data root paths and the project at each start), the copy-route .mcp.json arguments the installer resolved (@TOKEN@ placeholders), the pins and the dependency cut-off, the Python each uvx server ran on, and the navigation context the Serena launcher swapped in for claude-code. Read only - nothing in the stack loads it.

python.windows-control: 3.14 (the x64 build on Windows on ARM)

launchers.alfred-navigation: serena-launch.js: uvx on the pinned Python with the cut-off; SERENA_HOME at <data root>/serena/home; --context claude-code swapped for navigationContext below; the project folder at <data root>/serena
launchers.alfred-memory: memory-launch.js: the database at the install's level - ~/.alfred-memory/memory.db (global) or <project>/<data root>/.alfred-memory/memory.db (project) - then uvx --with numpy --from mcp-memory-service[sqlite] memory server
launchers.browser: browser-launch.js: npx -y @playwright/mcp --browser <engine> --user-data-dir <data root>/<engine>-control --output-dir <same>/output --no-webmcp, plus --secrets <the project's .sensitive-data> when it exists; absolute paths
launchers.windows-control: desktop-launch.js: exits on any OS but Windows; uvx on Python 3.14; the tool gate --exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,Process,FileSystem (ALFRED_CODE_WINDOWS_CONTROL_EXCLUDE replaced it, none dropped it)
launchers.macos-control: desktop-launch.js: exits on any OS but macOS; uvx on Python 3.13
launchers.mobile-control: mobile-launch.js: ANDROID_HOME and JAVA_HOME looked up when unset; NO_UI=true, ALLOW_REMOTE_APP_URLS=false and a local-only REMOTE_SERVER_URL_ALLOW_REGEX unless set; the screenshot and page-source folders under <data root>/mobile-control; npm_config_before the pin's own cut-off

alfred-navigation.args: -e SERENA_HOME=@SERENA_HOME@ -e SERENA_USAGE_REPORTING=false -- node -e @ROOT_BOOT@ -- checkout uvx --python @UV_PYTHON@ @UV_EXCLUDE_FLAG@ @UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER@ --from serena-agent@SERENA_PIN@ serena start-mcp-server --context @SERENA_CONTEXT@ --enable-web-dashboard false @SERENA_PROJECT_FLAG@ @SERENA_PROJECT_DIR@ --agent-interface tools

alfred-memory.args: -e MCP_MEMORY_STORAGE_BACKEND=@MEMORY_BACKEND@ -e MCP_MEMORY_SQLITE_PATH=@MEMORY_DB_PATH@ -e MCP_MEMORY_SQLITE_PRAGMAS=busy_timeout=15000 -- node -e @ROOT_BOOT@ -- project uvx --python @UV_PYTHON@ @UV_EXCLUDE_FLAG@ @UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER@ --with numpy --from mcp-memory-service[sqlite]@MEMORY_PIN@ memory server

windows-control.args: -e WINDOWS_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS=@WINDOWS_CONTROL_EXCLUDE@ -e WINDOWS_MCP_TOOLS= -e ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false -- uvx --python @WINDOWS_CONTROL_PYTHON@ @UV_EXCLUDE_FLAG@ @UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER@ --from windows-mcp@WINDOWS_CONTROL_PIN@ windows-mcp serve

mobile-control.args: -e NO_UI=@MOBILE_NO_UI@ -e ALLOW_REMOTE_APP_URLS=@MOBILE_REMOTE_APPS@ -e REMOTE_SERVER_URL_ALLOW_REGEX=@MOBILE_REMOTE_ALLOW@ -e SCREENSHOTS_DIR=@MOBILE_SCREENSHOTS@ -e PAGE_SOURCES_DIR=@MOBILE_PAGE_SOURCES@ -e npm_config_before=@MOBILE_BEFORE@ -- node -e @ROOT_BOOT@ -- checkout npx -y appium-mcp@MOBILE_CONTROL_PIN@

navigationContext:
# THE NAVIGATION SERVER'S CONTEXT - serena-agent 2.1.0's own `claude-code` context
# (src/serena/resources/config/contexts/claude-code.yml at the v2.1.0 tag, unchanged since 1.7.0), with a house
# prompt and twelve more tools off. The line below is that upstream file's hash: scripts/refresh-mcp-pins.js refuses a serena bump
# whose claude-code.yml hashes otherwise, until this file is re-diffed against it and the line re-recorded (R7).
# upstream: serena-agent 2.1.0 claude-code.yml sha256 78403573e7c71fe70b82253cb12a19b99b5c48f9702ea671f64257ad0e59c492
# serena reads it as a custom context: `--context <path>` takes a file when the value holds a path separator
# or ends in .yml (context_mode.py, SerenaAgentContext.load).
#
# Why: the upstream context serves seven file-writing tools, and a write through one of them bypasses every
# hook matched on Edit / Write (the config-protection guard, the docs hold, the turn's edit list, the done
# gate). The five plain writers are off; rename_symbol and safe_delete_symbol stay - reference-aware
# refactors a hand edit cannot match. onboarding is off: the capture skills own the project's orientation.
# The six memory tools are off (the user's 2026-10-13 ruling: this server is navigation only, memory is the
# alfred-memory MCP alone) - a seat's handoff note is an alfred-memory row tagged `handoff` (alfred-memory.md).
#
# The plugin route: serena-launch.js swaps the entry's `--context claude-code` for this file beside it. The
# full copy route: the installer copies it to the project's `.claude/navigation-context.yml` and registers the
# relative `--context .claude/navigation-context.yml`, resolved against the server's cwd - the checkout, where the
# row starts through ROOT_BOOT (2.1.5 R6: serena fails closed on a context path that does not resolve).
name: alfred-code
description: Alfred Code navigation - serena's claude-code context (single project; file, shell and search work is the harness's) with editing left to the harness except the reference-aware rename and safe delete.
prompt: |
  You are running inside Claude Code, whose own tools read files, search, run commands and edit. The
  house hooks watch those tools - config protection, the docs hold, the turn's edit list, the done gate -
  and see nothing this server writes, so every edit goes through the harness's Edit or Write tool.

  This server's job is code intelligence:
  - Locate before you read: get_symbols_overview for a file's structure, find_symbol for a symbol (its
    body only when you need it), find_referencing_symbols for its callers, find_declaration and
    find_implementations for the rest. Then read or edit the located range with the harness tools.
  - Two reference-aware refactors stay on this server: rename_symbol renames a symbol across the
    codebase, and safe_delete_symbol deletes one only when nothing still uses it. Prefer them to editing
    every usage by hand.
  - This server keeps no memory in this install: its memory tools are not served, and a note one agent
    leaves for the next goes through the alfred-memory MCP.

  Load only the tools the task needs through the tool search, not every tool at once. Where Serena's own
  manual below names replace_symbol_body, insert_after_symbol, insert_before_symbol, replace_content or
  replace_in_files, those tools are not served in this install: make that change with the Edit tool.

excluded_tools:
  # serena 1.7.0 claude-code's own six: file, shell and pattern-search work is the harness's
  - create_text_file
  - read_file
  - execute_shell_command
  - find_file
  - list_dir
  - search_for_pattern
  # the house's twelve: the plain writers no hook sees, onboarding, and every memory tool
  - replace_content
  - replace_in_files
  - replace_symbol_body
  - insert_after_symbol
  - insert_before_symbol
  - onboarding
  - write_memory
  - read_memory
  - list_memories
  - edit_memory
  - rename_memory
  - delete_memory

tool_description_overrides: {}

# Upstream's: with a project given at start, the tool set is cut to that project's own configuration and
# activate_project is off - project switching is not allowed.
single_project: true

# Upstream's: Claude Code does not unpack structured tool output, so it stays off.
structured_tool_output: false
